subject.title: fix(auth): cooldown inline api key billing failures

question: Should inline provider API keys be treated as provider-scoped credentials that fail closed during persisted auth/billing cooldowns across model lists, tools, and runtime selection?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive auth-provider behavior change: it fixes retry storms, but existing inline-key users may see a provider disappear or fail closed until the cooldown expires.

options.title: Accept provider-scoped cooldown after caller fix
options.body: Land the fail-closed inline-key cooldown behavior once every user-visible availability caller is wired to the same scoped store.

options.title: Keep inline keys always visible
options.body: Reject or narrow the fail-closed behavior and accept that inline-key billing failures can continue immediate retry behavior until a different design lands.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-scoped cooldown after caller fix
recommendation.body: Land the fail-closed inline-key cooldown behavior once every user-visible availability caller is wired to the same scoped store.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-auth and SecretRef work makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility call.
